# observability

RED signals per operation, tracing coverage and alarms that can actually notify - the OTel contract plus CloudWatch alarm posture.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-OBS-001` — CloudWatch alarm exists but its actions are disabled (medium)

`ActionsEnabled: false` means the alarm fires into nothing — the metric is watched, the pager is silent. The alarm list declares it.

Remediation: Enable actions or delete the alarm; a disabled alarm is worse than none because it looks like coverage.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/AlarmThatSendsEmail.html

### `AF-OBS-002` — CloudWatch alarm declares no action targets (high)

An alarm with an empty `AlarmActions` list transitions states and notifies nobody — same failure as disabled actions, declared directly by the field.

Remediation: Attach an SNS topic or auto-remediation target, or remove the alarm.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/AlarmThatSendsEmail.html

### `AF-OBS-003` — Step Functions state machine has X-Ray tracing disabled (low)

`tracingConfiguration.enabled` false means executions do not appear in X-Ray — cross-service flows through the orchestrator lose their trace segment.

Remediation: Enable tracing on machines orchestrating API flows; the overhead is small against an untraceable orchestration.

Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-xray-tracing.html
